articles.title: Fate/Extra Record - Official Caster Character Trailer - IGN
articles.summary: Meet Caster (VA: Chiwa Saito) in this latest Fate/Extra Record trailer for this upcoming RPG, and learn more about this sorceress with exceptional knowledge who excels at tactical combat. Caster is one of the Servants the protagonist can make a contract with. Fate/Extra Record will be available on Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Steam on January 28, 2027.Based on Fate/Extra, which released on the PlayStation Portable in 2010, Fate/Extra Record revises and expands the narrative to add new layers and depth to one of the franchise’s core entries, while also modernizing the title’s audio-visual presentation and adding an all-new strategic battle system that combines turn-based battles with a unique deck-building system.
articles.body:
Meet Caster (VA: Chiwa Saito) in this latest Fate/Extra Record trailer for this upcoming RPG, and learn more about this sorceress with exceptional knowledge who excels at tactical combat. Caster is one of the Servants the protagonist can make a contract with. Fate/Extra Record will be available on Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Steam on January 28, 2027.

Based on Fate/Extra, which released on the PlayStation Portable in 2010, Fate/Extra Record revises and expands the narrative to add new layers and depth to one of the franchise’s core entries, while also modernizing the title’s audio-visual presentation and adding an all-new strategic battle system that combines turn-based battles with a unique deck-building system.
